stories.title: Stampeders fire defensive co-ordinator Slowik
stories.summary: The Calgary Stampeders have fired defensive co-ordinator Bob Slowik after missing the CFL playoffs for the second time in three seasons.

stories.title: Alberta natural gas act a potential risk to TC Energy’s NGTL growth plans: CIBC analysts
stories.summary: CIBC analysts say in their report that provincial involvement could complicate the timing and economics of future expansions of the sprawling NOVA Gas Transmission Ltd. network.

stories.title: Provinces waiting to see if Trump follows through on data centre tax threat
stories.summary: Premier Tim Houston’s office said that Trump has made similar threats before, such as his call last year for 100 per cent tariffs on foreign films that never materialized.

stories.title: Woman dead after fire breaks out at southwest Calgary apartment building
stories.summary: A woman died after being found unconscious during a fire at an apartment building in the 7700 block of Elbow Drive in the Kingsland neighbourhood of southwest Calgary.

stories.title: Blood Tribe welcomes manslaughter charges against 3 Calgary police officers
stories.summary: 'The tragic outcome of Jon (Wells) passing cannot, and will not, be ignored,' said Blood Tribe Chief Traveller Plaited Hair after the criminal charges were laid.

stories.title: Alberta moves to reduce mandatory inquiries of deaths in custody
stories.summary: The Alberta government says the change would allow inquiries into deaths when they expect them to serve the public interest.

stories.title: Ullmark looks past great numbers to improve
stories.summary: Linus Ullmark is off to an impressive start this season, but the Ottawa Senators goaltender often remains his harshest critic.

stories.title: Ullmark leads Senators to 2-1 win over Flames
stories.summary: Linus Ullmark continued his impressive start to the season on Monday, making 34 saves to lead the Ottawa Senators to a 2-1 victory over the Calgary Flames.

stories.title: Calgary budget talks begin as hundreds sign up for public hearing
stories.summary: Calgary has proposed a 15 per cent property tax increase for 2027, which is expected to cost in an extra $53 monthly when combined with waste, recycling and water fee increases.

stories.title: Lions coach Pierce signs extension through 2029
